title: total_kills always 0 in all sessions
detail: All 8 sessions report total_kills=0 despite completing all 12 waves with victory and 20 lives remaining (0 leaks). Enemies are clearly being killed (visible in screenshots: dying enemies, boss kills, wave completions) but the kill counter is never incremented. This means kill-based mechanics (gold-on-kill, warden GrowthOnKill, session kill stats, combo/multi-kill detection) are all broken or disconnected from the reporting pipeline.

suggested_fix.description: The autoplay snapshot builder likely does not capture kills from emitKill() / event bus, or the report serializer reads from a field that is never updated. Check that stage.totalKills is incremented on every kill path (projectile, warden, skill) and that buildAutoPlaySnapshot() / report writer reads it.
